name: dumbbell one arm lunge
description: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.
